workspace.notFoundBody: This visit doesn't exist in this clinic, was discarded, or the link is out of date.
workspace.failedBody: Something went wrong while loading the visit.

discard.title: Discard this visit?
discard.body: Nothing has been recorded in it. Discarding removes it completely: it won't appear in the patient's history or balance.
discard.notEmpty: Something was recorded in this visit, so it can't be discarded. Complete it instead.

chartCard.title: Dental chart
chartCard.hint: Click a tooth to examine it · ← → to move, Esc to deselect

planBoard.title: Treatment plan
planBoard.subtitle: Future work · not billed until performed
planBoard.emptyBody: Select a tooth, record what you found, then plan the treatment. You can complete this visit as an examination without billing anything.

notes.title: Clinical notes
notes.subtitle: Belongs to this visit
notes.placeholder: What did you observe and do? e.g. Occlusal caries on {{tooth}}, isolated with rubber dam, restored with bio composite. Patient tolerated well.

money.draftSavedBody: Visit stays open — nothing has been recorded to history yet.
money.capped: Discount exceeds the subtotal — capped at 100%

startVisit.title: Start visit
startVisit.loadFailed: Couldn't load the dentists and rooms. Close this and try again.
startVisit.noBranch: Visits start in a branch, and none is selected. Pick one in the sidebar, or ask the clinic owner to assign you to one.
startVisit.noDentist: No dentist works in {{branch}} yet, so a visit can't start here.

errors.roomBusy: Another live visit is using this room
errors.roomInvalid: This room is no longer available
errors.dentistInvalid: This dentist no longer works in this branch
errors.archived: This patient is archived. Restore the record to start a visit.
errors.merged: This record was merged into another one. Start the visit from the kept record.
errors.branchRequired: Visits start in a branch, and this session has none. Switch branch and try again.

actions.performedBody: Moved from the treatment plan into this visit at {{price}}

succession.exfoliatedBody: The position now charts as the permanent successor. Its primary history stays on record.
succession.retainedBody: The position charts as the primary tooth again.

panel.emptyBody: Click any tooth in the chart to see its history and chart today’s treatment.
panel.hintSurface: Tap a surface to scope the next service
panel.hintSimple: Whole-tooth charting · surface view is off

diagnosis.label: Diagnosis
diagnosis.emptyTitle: No diagnosis recorded for this tooth
diagnosis.emptyBody: Record what you found before planning treatment.

plan.label: Treatment plan
plan.performTitle: Adds {{price}} to today’s visit as a completed service
plan.performedNote_one: One planned treatment performed — see below.
plan.emptyTitle: No planned treatment for this tooth
plan.emptyBody: Plan work now and bill it when it is performed — this visit or a later one.

completed.label: Completed
completed.emptyTitle: No treatment recorded for this tooth
completed.emptyBody: Its history starts with whatever you chart today.

service.title: Add completed service
service.footer: Adds the service to this visit and bills it now — price and discount stay editable in the tooth panel.

plan.title: Add planned treatment
plan.footer: Planned treatment is recorded on the tooth and is not billed until it is performed.

diagnosis.title: Add diagnosis
diagnosis.footer: A diagnosis records what you found. Add a planned treatment next to say what you intend to do about it.

drawer.noTooth: No tooth selected — jaw-level services only
drawer.noToothDiagnosis: No tooth selected — select a tooth first
drawer.noResultsBody: Check the spelling, or clear the category filter.
drawer.emptyBody: Add items on the Catalog screen first.
drawer.failedBody: Something went wrong while loading the catalog.

history.title: Tooth {{label}}
history.subtitle: {{name}} · {{patient}}
history.emptyTitle: No treatment recorded for this tooth
history.emptyBody: Chart it during a visit and it will appear here.
history.chartFailed: Couldn’t load the chart, so this tooth can’t be charted from here.
history.notShown: The chart shows {{label}} in this position: chart it there, or record which tooth is present from its panel in the visit.
